items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I never knew him, say, he'd played in Baton Rouge, really.

ctx.x: But as for Kid Thomas being the nearest thing to Keppard... I just wanted to see what you thought. To me there's no comparison at all. One is a first-class musician, the other is sort of...well, you know...

I've probably seen every one of these musicians at one time or another. I think that Buddy Bolden at one time was in my Dad's shoe-shop. Because Buddy Bolden died in the Jackson, Louisiana, insane asylum. I think he died in 1924.
